groups.operation: Recognize ||text|| as a spoiler span and render x-spoiler tags through md_html.
groups.condition: MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set and the input contains ||text||.
groups.capability: The harness passes the flag and input to md_html; the parser resolves double-pipe delimiters and the HTML callbacks emit x-spoiler tags.
groups.consequence: The spoiler span is not recognized or its x-spoiler tags are not emitted.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same spoiler parsing and rendering behavior under the same flag and input condition. They differ in their assessment of reachability, not in the hypothesis being normalized.

groups.operation: Retain HTML chunks emitted by md_html for later inspection.
groups.condition: md_html emits chunks through the caller-provided output callback.
groups.capability: The output callback stores emitted HTML chunks.
groups.consequence: Emitted chunks are unavailable for later inspection.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same output retention behavior, callback condition, required storage capability, and consequence.
